extracted.name: Lemongrass & crab crostini
extracted.description: Serve these moreish crab crostini to guests at your next party. Made with zesty lime and lemongrass, they make great nibbles at Christmas or new year
ingredient_lines: 1 red chilli finely chopped (deseeded, if you like)
1 lemongrass stalk woody leaves removed, finely chopped
100g Seafood & Eat It Fifty Fifty Crab (or use a total of 150g white crab, plus 50g brown crab)
instruction_lines: Combine the lime juice, fish sauce, sugar, chilli and lemongrass in a bowl. Season. Gently stir in the herbs and crabmeat, being careful not to break up the crab too much. Season, then chill until needed. Will keep chilled for a day.
Toast the sourdough, then peel the garlic and rub it over the toast. Cut into bite-sized chunks and top each with 1 tbsp of the crab mix. Top with the lime zest and serve.
